subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu identity source should OpenClaw use for multi-bot @mention recognition when WebSocket mention open_id values are scoped to another app?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the submitted union_id source is contradicted by issue and source evidence, and the identity choice directly controls whether Feishu group messages are delivered, suppressed, or misrouted.

options.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework the Feishu fix on current main only after proving the stable field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering every mention admission path.

options.title: Supersede With Alias Mapping
options.body: Move the canonical fix to a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app identifiers without relying on unavailable bot union_id data.

options.title: Close UnionId Branch
options.body: If maintainers confirm bot union_id is unavailable for this workflow, close this stale PR while keeping the canonical issue open for a different strategy.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the Feishu fix on current main only after proving the stable field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering every mention admission path.
